title: Repeat with a block
summary: Ruby: Repeat with a block. Add 6 to the array.
introduction: each visits each item. The name between vertical bars is the current item.
learningObjectives: Repeat with a block with Ruby

blocks.text: Install Ruby 3.1 or later. Save one example as lesson.rb and run ruby lesson.rb in a terminal.
The block input n takes each number in turn. puts runs once per value.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Use the current item n inside the block.
